facts.text: Jon thanked Gina for her support and expressed that her belief in him means the world to him.

evidence.quote: Thanks, Gina! Your belief in me means the world. I'm not gonna let anything or anyone stop me. I'll keep pushing and make my dreams come true. Thanks for being a great friend. You rock!
